recent_posts.Post Message: You hear it a lot — no invention has had a larger impact on human health than #vaccines.  They have saved an estimated 154 million lives over the past 50 years. That's a rate of six lives every minute.  For #WorldHealthDay this year, with the theme of #StandWithScience, we're sharing some of the science that makes vaccines effective and safe. ⤵️

When you work in vaccine development, your friends and family may or may not be able to explain exactly what you do every day... 💉Hear from a few members of Sabin's R&D team on how close their loved ones come to nailing their job description.  And as for the real work, here's an explainer on how vaccines are made safe and effective ⤵️ https://ow.ly/PTtR50YClMO

top_post.post_message: They toil for years, chasing the tantalizing promise of preventing devastating disease. They often have small budgets and little recognition. Yet when they strike gold, the entire world benefits.  Vaccinologists — some of the unsung heroes of global public health – work behind the scenes in laboratories around the world seeking to end suffering and death.   For one night, they are in the spotlight.  Read about the Sabin Awards, a prestigious honor which for the past 30 years has recognized those who spent their lives saving millions of others.   And see how to join us at this year’s celebration on May 12 via livestream.

board.public_perception_text: Sabin's social media presence continues to strengthen institutional reputation. Our messaging reaches diverse stakeholder groups with strong engagement metrics. Positive sentiment reflects public confidence in our vaccine research and immunization initiatives.
board.donor_engagement_text: Social channels serve as critical touchpoints for demonstrating research impact and organizational effectiveness. Quarterly reports of breakthrough achievements drive stakeholder engagement and support fundraising objectives. Expanding reach indicates growing influence in vaccine policy discussions.
board.risk_management_text: Consistent engagement monitoring identifies potential reputational risks early. Current positioning addresses vaccine concerns and establishes Sabin as trusted authority. Social media serves as early warning system enabling rapid response to misinformation.
